title: Deploy script evals a value taken from the environment

base.deploy.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
TARGET="${DEPLOY_TARGET:-staging}"
case "$TARGET" in staging|prod) ;; *) echo bad target; exit 1;; esac
./deploy-to "$TARGET"

labels.defect: Allow-list replaced by eval of an environment-controlled string
labels.evidence: eval "./deploy-to $DEPLOY_TARGET" executes any shell in DEPLOY_TARGET (e.g. `prod; curl …`); the previous case statement was the control.
